findings.observation: All 12 quoted routes had negative gross output versus the 1000000000000000 wei input. The best returned 999570115907177 wei, a gross shortfall of 429884092823 wei; the lowest returned 982009529052375 wei. Thus lowering the edge threshold would not create a positive gross edge in this observation.

Modelled known gas was approximately 6.97e12 wei per quote (gas units multiplied by the recorded gas price), making every route more negative before any unmodelled costs. Extra gas and infrastructure costs are null, so fully cost-adjusted results cannot be established.

The packet contains one observation and 12 quotes, but zero baseline and candidate trades; paper net is null and costs are incomplete. Quotes are not actual fills. The saved-snapshot source check indicates provider consistency, not signed consensus or execution proof.
